about.gap.closing: Sometimes you don't need another answer. You need somewhere to work with what you already know.
about.hero.closing: And yet, in the middle of real life, it can still be hard to live what you’ve learned.
about.philosophy.point1: You get better at trusting your own judgement.
about.shift.point2: You learn to make more of the “good” moments.
about.why.body1: Therapy sessions and coaching calls happen on a schedule. Getting triggered in the middle of your actual life doesn’t. You’re in the middle of a hard conversation on a Tuesday night, your nervous system takes over, and suddenly everything you know is nowhere to be found.
about.why.body2: Your therapist can’t live in your pocket. But the questions, practices, and tools that help you work with what’s happening can.
home.deeper.body1: You choose what you need, when you need it.
home.deeper.body2: Come in with something specific. Explore what’s on your mind. Take a few minutes to reset, or stay awhile and go deeper. There’s no right way to use Uncoached.
home.deeper.bullet1: Choose what you need in the moment.
home.deeper.bullet2: Go as light or as deep as you want.
home.deeper.bullet3: Come back whenever something new comes up.
home.deeper.subtitle: There’s nothing to complete, keep up with, or get right. Uncoached meets you wherever you are that day.
home.deeper.title: Use It How You Need It
home.field.body1: Field isn’t here to coach, advise, or analyze you. And he definitely doesn’t talk like a robot. He’s got a personality of his own.
home.field.body2: Bring him whatever’s on your mind. Field will chat with you, challenge you, dig deeper, make you laugh, and sometimes ask the question you didn’t know you needed.
home.field.body3: Field helps you slow things down, hear yourself more clearly, and figure out what’s actually going on underneath it all.
home.gift.body: Gift them access to Uncoached, so they have a space that's theirs whenever they need it.
home.gift.subtitle: For someone going through something, working through something, or simply wanting more for themselves.
home.gift.title: Give Someone a Little More Space for Themselves
home.hero.subtitle: Your self-guided space for working through whatever life throws at you, right when you need it.
home.hero.title: When real life happens,
home.integrate.card1_body: Your thoughts won’t let something go. Slow it down, sort through what’s actually going on, and find your footing.
home.integrate.card2_body: You just realized something about yourself. Stay with it, explore what it means, and take it further before life moves on.
home.integrate.card3_body: You know what’s going on. Now figure out what you actually want to do with it and take your next step .
home.integrate.intro: Practical tools for whatever life brings up, including resources created with therapists, coaches, and practitioners.
home.integrate.title: This Is What You Reach For
home.services.card1_body: An AI companion you can talk to in real time. Field helps you slow it down, sort through what’s actually going on, and figure out what you need next.
home.services.card2_body: Short guided audios that help you breathe through the moment when you’re overwhelmed, worked up, or just need help coming back down and grounding yourself.
home.services.card3_body: Pen-to-paper questions and exercises that help you unpack what’s on your mind, see what’s really going on, and get clear on what you want.
home.services.card4_body: Copy-and-paste prompts for Field or your favourite AI chat that help you work through something specific, get clearer on what’s going on, and figure out what you want to do with it.
home.services.card5_body: Short guided experiences that walk you through what you’re feeling and help you shift what’s happening in the moment.
home.services.card6_body: Positive questions that help you look at something differently, notice possibilities you may be missing, and shift the conversation happening in your head.
home.services.card7_body: Short voice notes for the moments you need someone in your ear reminding you that you’re okay, helping you find your footing, or giving you a little perspective.
home.services.card8_body: Uncoached will keep growing, with new tools, experiences, and practitioner-created resources added along the way.
home.services.intro: Talk it through. Ground yourself. Follow a prompt. Capture an insight. Shift your perspective. Plus, explore practical resources contributed by therapists, coaches, and practitioners.
home.services.subtitle: Different tools for different moments, because you won’t always need the same thing.
home.subscribe.body: Occasional grounding notes, reflections, new tools, Field updates, and little things to help you come back to yourself. No inbox clutter. No constant selling.
legal.privacy.body:
Uncoached (“we,” “our,” “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website, downloadable tools, and our AI companion, Field.

By using Uncoached, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

## 1. Information We Collect
We collect two main types of information.

Information you provide:
• When you purchase The Uncoached Essentials (via Stripe), we collect your name, email address, and payment details. Payment information is processed securely by Stripe and is never stored by us.
• When you interact with Field, you may provide personal reflections, journal-like entries, or other text responses.
• When you apply to the Practitioner Partnership, we collect the details and headshot you submit in the application form.

Automatically collected information:
• Basic usage data, such as browser type, device type, IP address, and pages visited on our site.
• Email opt-ins (if you subscribe), which include your name and email address.

Practitioner Information:
If you apply to join the Uncoached Practitioner Partnership, we may collect information you provide through the practitioner application, such as your name, contact information, professional background, areas of focus, location, languages, website or social media links, headshot, and other information you choose to provide.

We use this information to review your application, communicate with you about the Practitioner Partnership, and administer the partnership. If you are accepted, information you have provided for your practitioner profile may be published on the Uncoached website so that Uncoached users can learn about you and your work.

Information submitted as part of an application that is not intended for your public practitioner profile, such as your email address or other administrative information, will not be published unless you have specifically agreed to its publication.

## 2. How We Use Your Information
• Provide and deliver Uncoached products (printable toolkits, add-on tools, rituals, AI access).
• Enable and improve your experience with Field, our AI companion.
• Review Practitioner Partnership applications and administer the partnership.
• Send you updates you've opted into (e.g., new cards, behind-the-scenes tools, or Field's secret features).
• Maintain and improve site performance and user experience.

## 3. AI Assistant (Field) and Chatbase
When you interact with Field, your entries are processed by our service provider Chatbase, which hosts the AI model on our behalf.
• You do not need a Chatbase account; everything happens directly inside the Uncoached website.
• Your messages are used to generate responses within Field and to operate, maintain, and improve the functionality and quality of the Services. Your entries are not used to train public AI models.
• Chatbase processes information on our behalf in accordance with its applicable privacy and security practices.
• If you delete your cookies, Field will refresh and you will lose any previously stored memories within Field.

We recommend avoiding sensitive personal details (such as medical, financial, or legal information) when using Field.

## 4. How We Share Information
We do not sell your personal data. We only share information in the following limited ways:
• Service providers: With trusted partners like Stripe (for payments) and Chatbase (for Field's AI responses).
• Legal compliance: If required by law or to protect our rights and safety.

## 5. Data Retention
• Email and purchase details are retained as long as necessary for customer support, tax, and legal obligations.
• Entries shared with Field are processed by Chatbase and may be stored for a limited period as necessary to provide the Service and improve reliability.
• Practitioner applications are retained so we can review them and maintain the practitioner community.

## 6. Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
• Access, correct, or delete your personal information.
• Opt out of communications at any time (unsubscribe link provided in every email).
• Request that we limit or stop processing your data.

To exercise these rights, email us at hello@uncoached.space.

## 7. Security
We use reasonable measures to protect your personal information. However, no system is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.

## 8. Children's Privacy
Uncoached is not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

## 9. Updates to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we'll update the effective date at the top of this page. Significant changes will be communicated clearly.

## 10. Contact
For privacy concerns, email us at hello@uncoached.space.
